name: skip-silence
description: Runs fast through silence at the start of a track, and goes on to the next one when the end is silence.

start.label: At the start
start.description: Silence in the first 15 seconds plays at triple speed, which nobody hears.

end.label: At the end
end.description: Silence of a second and a half in the last 20 seconds goes on to the next track.

threshold.label: Silence below
threshold.description: Lower counts less as silence: a quiet intro stays.
